name: 三味混合胶囊咖啡礼盒款

shots.intent: 首屏立信任：黑色礼盒加三色胶囊一眼看懂混合配比与礼盒质感
风味词加方格强度标尺横向对比，十秒完成选味

四款成品热饮冰饮斜线排开，把多种喝法变成欲望图
认证与责任声明收口，只留信任结构不做背书

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: a premium coffee-capsule gift-set system built on two alternating layers. Layer one is seamless pure-white #FFFFFF studio infographics under soft top light with gentle contact shadows and floor reflections, thin-weight letterspaced uppercase headlines with bold key numbers, 1.5px line-stroke icons and square-step intensity gauges. Layer two is warm documentary photography - golden backlit hands sifting beans, faceless farmers among red cherries, misty rainforest aerials, kitchen recycling moments - always framed as one-third photo to two-thirds off-white #F1EDE6 text-panel split at 3200-3800K. A three-flavor color code (espresso gold #C98F4E, lake blue #1B6E93, olive green #4A6741) runs across capsules, bands and gauges on a charcoal #1A1A1A and white base. Circularity uses a gold line-drawn leaf motif over scattered grounds; every finished cup shows thick hazel crema; certifications and impact claims appear only when verified. No brand wordmarks, no machine hero shots, no subscription messaging, no third-party logos, no identifiable faces.
noDrift: no brand wordmarks or capsule-face engravings
